scope: Example ex:p19 of the geonormal manuscript at p = 19. Unconditional: X is a projective, proper, integral, regular surface over k = F_19(c) with H^0(X, O_X) = k, not smooth over k, whose absolute differentials are locally free of rank three and whose normalized differential line is trivial. Conditional on GeneralClassicalAdjunction: X has a canonical sheaf, and every canonical sheaf of X is trivial.
p11_scope: Proposition prop:p11 of the geonormal manuscript at p = 11. Unconditional: X is a projective, proper, integral, regular surface over k = F_11(c) with H^0(X, O_X) = k, not geometrically normal (its base change to k' = k(c^(1/11)) is not normal), whose absolute differentials are locally free of rank three and whose normalized differential line is trivial. Conditional on GeneralClassicalAdjunction: X has a canonical sheaf, and every canonical sheaf of X is trivial.

ingredients: functorial lci adjunction and presentation-independent gluing
top-degree Serre duality expressed in Ext cohomology
